counter_hypotheses: The opposing Level-1 imbalances may reflect venue-specific market-maker inventory, order placement or cancellation rather than a market-wide supply/demand imbalance.
The raw Kraken USD versus OKX USDT last-price gap may be explained by quote-asset basis, timing and fees rather than executable arbitrage.
A bid-heavy OKX top level does not imply durable support because the displayed order can be cancelled or consumed; Kraken's ask-heavy top level is not a market-wide resistance estimate.
disconfirming_evidence: No synchronized event timestamps across the two venues.
No multi-level depth or executed-trade tape.
Binance derivatives endpoints were unavailable in this retrieval path.
No exchange-flow or liquidation data was captured.

model_admission.reason: Freshness and synchronization controls fail; Level-1 data is insufficient for a market-wide feature.
